newsitem.title: UK: Saudi Aramco seeks 300,000 bbls gasoline - traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco seeks 300,000 bbls gasoline - traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is looking to buy some 300,000 barrels of gasoline for delivery in early May, traders said on Tuesday.

They said Saudi Aramco had probed a number of oil companies over the past few days about the possibility of supplying some 300,000 barrels of 95-octane 0.4 grammes per litre gasoline to be delivered into Ras Tanura in early May.
"They're looking on the spot market," said one trader. "There isn't an actual tender."
European gasoline players said they expected the product to be supplied out of the Far or Middle East.
"The numbers don't work out of the Med at the moment," said one trader.
"The bid's quite low, it wouldn't be feasible out of the West," said another.
Last month, Aramco decided not to award a tender for up to 1.5 million barrels of similar quality gasoline for April delivery due to the high prices of offers.
At the time, offers into the tender for 95-octane 0.4 grammes per litre gasoline were at a premium of $5.00-$6.00 per barrel over the same Singapore quotes on a cost-and-freight basis to Ras Tanura.
